hook: Extreme macro close-up of a single glowing bioluminescent lure of a deep-sea anglerfish, a small orb of cold blue-green light hanging on a thin stalk in absolute black water, tiny drifting particles catching the light, the faint silhouette of needle-like teeth just visible behind it, cinematic, photorealistic, shallow depth of field, ultra detailed, vertical composition
angler: Deep-sea humpback anglerfish, round dark-brown body, wide open mouth with long translucent fang-like teeth, a thin fishing-rod spine growing from its forehead ending in a glowing blue-green bulb, hovering in pitch-black abyssal water with drifting marine snow, realistic BBC deep-sea documentary photograph, sharp focus, vertical composition
squid: Close-up of a group of small firefly squid (Watasenia scintillans) swimming in dark night sea water, each translucent squid body covered with dozens of glowing electric-blue photophore dots, arms tipped with bright blue lights, more glowing squid sparkling in the background like stars, realistic underwater macro photography, vertical composition
jelly: A deep-sea Atolla jellyfish glowing with a pinwheel ring of brilliant blue bioluminescent light in pure black water, translucent red bell, delicate tentacles, photorealistic deep-sea documentary photography, vertical composition
vampire: A vampire squid in the dark deep ocean, deep red body with webbed cloak-like arms spread, large blue eyes, glowing blue light organs at its arm tips, a faint cloud of glowing blue particles drifting from it, photorealistic deep-sea documentary still, vertical composition
waves: Night beach with ocean waves breaking and glowing bright electric blue from bioluminescent plankton, dark starry sky, wet sand reflecting blue light, no people, photorealistic long exposure photography, vertical composition
ending: Wide view of the deep ocean abyss filled with many different glowing bioluminescent creatures, jellyfish, squid and tiny plankton sparkling blue, cyan and violet in deep darkness, awe-inspiring, cinematic, photorealistic, vertical composition
